text: The visual theme is defined by high-altitude serenity and crisp, clean aesthetics. The palette should center on cool whites and icy blues from the snow-capped peaks, contrasted with the deep, rich greens of pine forests and the bright, clear azure of the sky above the clouds. Lighting should be bright and diffused, capturing the glistening quality of sunlight on snow and the sharp clarity of thin mountain air. Textures should feel smooth and airy, evoking the whisper of wind and the vast, open space of the panoramic view. The overall mood is one of solitude, contemplation, and pristine natural beauty.
